ruleDefinitions.name: Windows Shell/Scripting Application File Write to Suspicious Folder
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Windows shells and scripting applications that write files to suspicious folders

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\bash\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msbuild\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\sh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")) AND (file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\PerfLogs\\\\") OR file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\"))) OR ((process_path = RGX("\\\\certutil\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\forfiles\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\scriptrunner\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wmic\\\.exe$")) AND (file_path = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\PerfLogs\\\\.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*"))))
